questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “ancient”:
questions.why: 'Ancient' means very old; its opposite is 'modern'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct modal: “When I was young, I ______ swim across the river.”
questions.why: 'Could' expresses ability in the past. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: “You ought ____ respect your elders.”
questions.why: 'Ought' is followed by 'to' + base verb. GPSC-style practice item.
The word has double c and double m. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct modal: “You ______ wear a helmet; it is the law.”
questions.why: 'Must' expresses obligation. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Identify the function of the underlined word: “He came yesterday.”
questions.why: 'Yesterday' tells when he came. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: “Government by the people”
questions.why: Democracy is rule by the people, directly or through elected representatives. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Select the correct indirect speech: The boy said, “I have finished my homework.”
opts: The boy said that he has finished his homework.
The boy said that I had finished my homework.
The boy said that he finished his homework.
The boy said that he had finished his homework.
questions.why: Present perfect backshifts to past perfect; pronouns change. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In the sentence “The book that you lent me is interesting,” the clause “that you lent me” is a:
questions.why: It qualifies the noun 'book', so it is an adjective clause. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “I would have attended the seminar if I ____ about it earlier.”
questions.why: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + past participle. GPSC-style practice item.
